title: Popover Action Menu
prompt: Build a 'Row actions' menu with zero JavaScript: a button with popovertarget="row-menu" opening a <div id="row-menu" popover> that contains at least two action buttons and one close button using popovertarget="row-menu" popovertargetaction="hide".

tests.name: invoker targets the popover
tests.hint: popovertarget on the button is the whole wiring — no addEventListener needed.

tests.name: popover element exists
tests.hint: The id the button targets must carry popover — that is what turns it into a popover.

tests.name: menu holds real actions
tests.hint: Two actions and one close = three buttons inside the popover.

tests.name: close button hides its own popover
tests.hint: A button inside the popover that targets it with action=hide is the idiomatic close affordance.
